claim_scope: Compare available bounded scorer sources on the latest Stage11431 selected-test Rust runtime.
This is an inference-side architecture audit only; it does not train or promote a new model.
decision_basis: A scorer source must preserve strict >=22/23 and validation >=20/23 while improving reserved above 5/10.
If no existing source satisfies this, the next implementation step is a trained semantic scorer/objective rather than more support-row probes.
